ordering_deviation_disclosed: AGENTS.md requires the snapshot commit to PRECEDE any independent read. It did not here: the Coordinator dispatched the validator and red-team agents in the same orchestration step as the executor, so review began before this commit was made. THIS IS RECORDED AS A DEVIATION, NOT GLOSSED. Mitigation, and its limit: the four artifacts were written once by the executor and were not modified afterwards, and the sha256 values above pin exactly the bytes committed here; a reviewer can recompute them and confirm they read these bytes. What the deviation genuinely costs is the GUARANTEE -- the ordering exists so that freezing is enforced by construction rather than argued after the fact, and an argued freeze is weaker than an enforced one. The next batch restores the ordering by running the snapshot as its own dispatched step before review agents start.
